basic_details.job_title: NHM Uttara Kannada Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 24 Laboratory Technician, DEIC Manager and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The District Health and Family Welfare Officer, Uttara Kannada, Karwar has invited applications for 24 posts in 11 designations, to be filled on contract for one year under the National Health Mission, PM ABHIM and NUHM. Application forms are issued from 30 November 2026 at 10:30 AM at the office of the District RCH Officer, Karwar. Filled applications with original documents for verification must be submitted at the same office by 10 December 2026, 5:30 PM.

content_sections.heading: About the Recruiting Office
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the District Health and Family Welfare Officer, Uttara Kannada, Karwar, and is titled a press release on recruitment to posts vacant under various programmes of the National Health Mission, PM ABHIM and NUHM. The posts are for one year on contract, on a roster-cum-merit basis as per government guidelines. The letterhead gives the office email [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: This is a collect-and-submit process at one office: the Office of the District RCH Officer, Office of the District Health and Family Welfare Officer, Karwar. The notice prints no street address, PIN or postal mode. Collect the application form from the District RCH Officer's office, Karwar, from 30 November 2026, 10:30 AM. The last time to obtain forms is 10 December 2026, 3:30 PM. Submit the filled application, together with the original documents for verification, at the same office by 10 December 2026, 5:30 PM. The notice also says that if a government holiday is declared on a specified day, the process is carried out on the next working day.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the NHM Uttara Kannada recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 24 posts in 11 designations: DEIC Manager 1, Audiologist 2, X-Ray Technician 4, Ophthalmic Assistant 3 and 1, Physiotherapist 2, Laboratory Technician 6, Epidemiologist 1, Diet Counselor 1, Insect Collector 1, Psychologist (DEIC) 1 and Optometrist (DEIC) 1.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The filled application with original documents must be submitted by 10 December 2026, 5:30 PM at the District RCH Officer's office, Karwar. Forms can be obtained until 3:30 PM the same day.

faq.question: Q3. When do application forms become available?
faq.answer: Distribution of applications starts on 30 November 2026 from 10:30 AM at the District RCH Officer's office, Karwar.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years for all posts except Insect Collector, where it is 40 years. The notice gives no minimum age.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for Laboratory Technician?
faq.answer: SSLC or equivalent with a 3-year laboratory technology diploma, or 2nd PUC Science with a 2-year diploma, from the Karnataka Paramedical Board. The notice also requires 2 years' experience and current Karnataka Paramedical Board registration.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the posts?
faq.answer: Monthly pay ranges from Rs. 15,114 (Insect Collector) to Rs. 30,000 (Epidemiologist). Laboratory Technician pay is as per the Minimum Wages Act.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Posts are filled as per NHM guidelines on a roster-cum-merit basis. The notice describes no written test or interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the posts are on contract for one year under the National Health Mission, PM ABHIM and NUHM.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: Postings are at places such as District Hospital Karwar, Taluk Hospital Sirsi and Yellapur, Vision Centres at Joida, Sirsi and Mundgod, and the DVBDCO office, Karwar, depending on the post.
